song: morning — first day and I can log into console.staging but when I open Feature Flags it says 403. Anyone seen this?
marco: welcome! usually you need the staging-flag-read role from Okta. Did you accept the provisioning email?
song: yep accepted, shows in the "staging-app" but UI still 403. CLI curl to /api/v1/flags returns missing scope.
marco: are you on the org SSO session or using a service key? SSO group claims sometimes lag.
song: browser SSO. No service key.
devex-bot: Short-lived admin offer created for song — request #501 expires in 3h. Approvers: infra.
marco: I granted a 2h staging-flag-admin while infra checks mapping. Try refresh.
song: still 403 after refresh.
infra-oncall: running Okta->RBAC sync now. Found mapping for rw-staging-flag-read was missing. Pushing fix.
song: thanks, will retry.
infra-oncall: sync done, mapping added: Okta group rw-staging-flag-read -> console.flag.read.
song: works now, can see flags :tada:
song: quick q — want to canary a change in staging, what's the recommended flow?
marco: use the console UI for interactive canaries. For scripts use rwctl: rwctl flags toggle --env staging --flag feature-x --on --reason "song onboarding smoke" --actor song
tess: note: we gave short-lived admin while debugging. If you need longer access ping marco with justification. Always use --reason for audit.
song: got it, will add the rwctl example to my notes and update the onboarding doc. Thanks!
